title: Harnessing desiccation-tolerant cyanobacteria as biosensors for LexA-mediated responses in deep space.
authors: Martella, Costanza Maria; Di Stefano, Giorgia; Chirico, Antonio; D'Agostino, Andrea; D'Andrea, Marco Maria; Colini, Flavio; Iacovelli, Federico; Falconi, Mattia; Verna, Adriano; Scifo, Jessica; Cemmi, Alessia; Billi, Daniela
one_liner_zh: 该文利用蓝藻构建LexA介导的SOS响应生物传感器，通过分子建模和MD模拟验证LexA-DNA结合，虽非典型TF-DNA体系但涉及蛋白-DNA互作建模，方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: A LexA-mediated biosensor tailored for space applications was developed leveraging the desert cyanobacterium Chroococcidiopsis sp. CCMEE 029 engineered with a transcriptional fusion between an SOS-responsive promoter and a luciferase gene reporter. METHODS: The SOS DNA repair system was investigated by bioinformatics analysis that identified a lexA gene in the genome CCMEE 029 encoding a protein sharing key structural features with other cyanobacterial homologs. Consensus LexA-binding motifs upstream genes involved in DNA-damage repair, photosynthesis, and oxidative-stress defense were computationally identified and the DNA binding of CCMEE 029' LexA was confirmed by molecular modeling and molecular dynamics simulations. The expression of lexA and recA after treatment for 30 min with 10 mM H(2)O(2) was evaluated by RT-qPCR. Then Chroococcidiopsis sp. CCMEE 029 was transformed with a plasmid carrying a transcriptional fusion between the upstream region of the recA gene containing the LexA-binding motif and a firefly luciferase gene. The biosensor responsiveness was tested in response to DNA-damaging agents, after desiccation as well as under simulated microgravity conditions combined with gamma-rays. RESULTS: Upon the addition of the luciferin substrate, Chroococcidiopsis transformants exposed to DNA-damaging agents (H(2)O(2), ultra-violet C (UVC), and gamma-ray irradiation) emitted a bioluminescent signal. A correlation was detected between increased UVC doses and the onset of detectable DNA damage. The biosensor responsiveness was confirmed under simulated microgravity conditions combined with gamma-rays used as a proxy of the space environment. Notably, the biosensor responsiveness was retained after 4.5 months of air-dried storage as demonstrated by signal emission after rehydration and UVC and gamma-ray irradiation. DISCUSSION: Although a more global stress management role for LexA remains to be investigated in Chroococcidiopsis sp. CCMEE 029. The tested biosensor's feature supports a future integration of the air-dried biosensor into satellites and its in-orbit reactivation for real-time monitoring of the effects of space conditions, thus advancing future space exploration.
abstract_zh: 引言：开发了一种适用于太空应用的LexA介导生物传感器，利用沙漠蓝藻Chroococcidiopsis sp. CCMEE 029，该菌株通过SOS响应启动子与荧光素酶基因报告基因之间的转录融合进行工程化改造。方法：通过生物信息学分析研究SOS DNA修复系统，在CCMEE 029基因组中鉴定出一个lexA基因，其编码的蛋白质与其他蓝藻同源物共享关键结构特征。通过计算鉴定了参与DNA损伤修复、光合作用和氧化应激防御的基因上游的共识LexA结合基序，并通过分子建模和分子动力学模拟确认了CCMEE 029 LexA的DNA结合能力。通过RT-qPCR评估了用10 mM H(2)O(2)处理30分钟后lexA和recA的表达情况。随后，用携带recA基因上游区域（含LexA结合基序）与萤火虫荧光素酶基因之间转录融合的质粒转化Chroococcidiopsis sp. CCMEE 029。测试了生物传感器对DNA损伤剂、干燥处理后以及模拟微重力条件与γ射线组合下的响应性。结果：添加荧光素底物后，暴露于DNA损伤剂（H(2)O(2)、紫外线C (UVC)和γ射线照射）的Chroococcidiopsis转化体发出生物发光信号。检测到UVC剂量增加与可检测DNA损伤出现之间的相关性。在模拟微重力条件与γ射线组合（作为太空环境的代理）下，生物传感器的响应性得到确认。值得注意的是，经过4.5个月空气干燥储存后，生物传感器的响应性得以保留，这通过复水及UVC和γ射线照射后的信号发射得到证明。讨论：尽管LexA在Chroococcidiopsis sp. CCMEE 029中更广泛的应激管理作用仍有待研究，但所测试生物传感器的特性支持未来将空气干燥的生物传感器集成到卫星中，并在轨道上重新激活以实时监测太空条件的影响，从而推进未来的太空探索。
